name: Farsight Alteration

active.name: Trinket
active.effects: Places a visible Farsight Ward at the target location that grants sight of the surrounding area, including over terrain and through brush and lasting indefinitely. Also grants sight of the area in a 800 radius for 2 seconds. Upon detecting an enemy champion, the ward will increase its sight radius to 800 units and destroy itself after 3 seconds.

description:
Active (198 - 99s)
Reveals a distant area for 2 seconds and leaves a Ward that expires upon spotting an enemy champion.
